# Lorna Vane

## Overview

- **Age:** Twenty-eight  <sub>[v4 c10 P49](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0049)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v4 c10 P44](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0044)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive  <sub>[v4 c38 P10](../source/v04-c38.md#nw-v04-c38-p0010)</sub>
- **Origin:** Seven Gulls  <sub>[v4 c11 P15](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0015)</sub>
- **Role:** Former schoolteacher  <sub>[v4 c11 P28](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0028)</sub>
- **Titles:** Mrs. Rufus Vane  <sub>[v4 c5 P8](../source/v04-c05.md#nw-v04-c05-p0008), [v4 c10 P11](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0011)</sub>; Mrs. Carrow's closest friend  <sub>[v4 c10 P39](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0039)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Lorna; The girl possessing the magnificent, indignant eyes  <sub>[v4 c5 P8](../source/v04-c05.md#nw-v04-c05-p0008)</sub>

## Appearance

Lorna is described as possessing an extraordinary and striking beauty that stands out to everyone who sees her. She has a tall, splendid figure, cream-white skin, and an expressive face with an asymmetrical mouth and a crimson lip. Her eyes are a deep, ocean-blue, and her most remarkable feature is her thick, shining hair the color of ripe wheat, which reaches down to her feet when unbound. She often wears simple dresses adorned with a signature flash or sash of red.

_Sources: [v4 c5 P8](../source/v04-c05.md#nw-v04-c05-p0008), [v4 c6 P0](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0000), [v4 c10 P6](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0006), [v4 c11 P15](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0015), [v4 c26 P15](../source/v04-c26.md#nw-v04-c26-p0015)_

## Personality

Lorna possesses a deep, passionate, and proud nature with an intense capacity for feeling both grief and joy. Though she maintains a guarded, cold, and aloof exterior due to years of severe hardship, she is warm, witty, and vivid when she feels comfortable. She is fiercely loyal, self-sacrificing, and holds an uncompromising sense of duty. Underneath her reserved demeanor lies an imaginative spirit that deeply loves beauty, nature, music, and poetry.

_Sources: [v4 c10 P6](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0006), [v4 c10 P21](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0021), [v4 c10 P44](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0044), [v4 c11 P15](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0015), [v4 c11 P28](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0028), [v4 c14 P6](../source/v04-c14.md#nw-v04-c14-p0006)_

## History

Lorna grew up in Seven Gulls in a poor but loving family. Tragedy struck early when her younger brother Julian was killed in an accident, and two years later her beloved father committed suicide. Determined to make a life for herself and her frail mother, Lorna studied at Regent's Academy and became a successful teacher at the Glen school. However, when she was sixteen, Rufus Vane threatened her mother with foreclosure, coercing Lorna into marrying him. Shortly after, her mother died, and Rufus went to sea on the Four Sisters. When the ship failed to return, he was presumed dead, but Captain Saul later discovered him in Havana, suffering from complete amnesia caused by a head injury. Brought back to Seven Gulls, Lorna spent eleven years faithfully caring for him as an invalid child. After Nell Harcourt moved to Seven Gulls, the two formed a deep, life-changing friendship that brought Lorna back to life. Eventually, Dr. Hugh Carrow realized Rufus's condition could be cured through surgery. Lorna bravely agreed to the operation. The procedure succeeded in restoring his memory, revealing a startling truth: the man Lorna had been caring for was actually Rufus's cousin, Laurence Vane, and the real Rufus had died in Cuba years before.

_Sources: [v4 c11 P12](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0012), [v4 c11 P13](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0013), [v4 c11 P20](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0020), [v4 c11 P28](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0028), [v4 c11 P33](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0033), [v4 c11 P34](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0034), [v4 c11 P35](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0035), [v4 c21 P28](../source/v04-c21.md#nw-v04-c21-p0028), [v4 c32 P0](../source/v04-c32.md#nw-v04-c32-p0000), [v4 c38 P9](../source/v04-c38.md#nw-v04-c38-p0009)_

## Background by volume

- Daughter of Frank Ainslie and Rose Kerr  <sub>[v4 c11 P12](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0012), [v4 c11 P15](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0015)</sub>
- Her younger brother, Julian, was tragically killed in a farm accident when she was twelve  <sub>[v4 c11 P13](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0013), [v4 c11 P14](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0014)</sub>
- Her father committed suicide when she was fourteen  <sub>[v4 c11 P20](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0020)</sub>
- Attended Regent's Academy and worked as a teacher at the Glen school  <sub>[v4 c11 P28](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0028)</sub>
- Coerced into marrying Rufus Vane at sixteen to save her mother from foreclosure  <sub>[v4 c11 P28](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0028)</sub>
